## Endpoints

### Data Read (9)
- `GET /ads/ga-audiences` — Retrieve Google Analytics audience data for ads.
- `GET /api/betting/bettypes` — Get available bet types.
- `GET /api/Page/{PageId}` — Get content for a specific page by ID.
- `GET /api/Popular/8` — Retrieve popular events for a specific category.
- `GET /api/sports/8/countries` — Get countries for a specific sport.
- `GET /api/tournaments/horseracing/{horseracingId}` — Get tournament data for horseracing by ID.
- `GET /api/v1/{v1Id}` — Retrieve data for a specific item by ID (v1).
- `GET /live-or-upcoming/sports` — Get a list of live or upcoming sports events.
- `GET /pagead/1p-user-list/{1p-user-listId}/` — Retrieve a 1P user list by ID.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /Hollywoodbets/dcs/tagController/tagData/{tagDataHash}` — Submit tag data to Hollywoodbets DCS.
- `POST /push/api/{apiId}` — Send push notifications.

### Realtime (1)
- `GET /api/events/eps/sports` — Get real-time event data for sports.

### Config (1)
- `GET /api/Settings` — Retrieve application settings.

### Core API (1)
- `GET /wejs` — Fetch core we.js framework data.
